newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower because of the absence of institutional investors and selling pressure by retailers, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 22.90 points or 1.89 percent at 1,470.22 on a turnover of 75.0 million taka on Sunday. Friday is moslem weekend. Losers led gainers by 128 to 36. "The investors were just selling in a market that slid in previous two sessions. Moreover, the institutional investors were absent in the market," said one broker.
Bangladesh Lamps lost 36 taka to 5,942, food scrips Pran shed 24 to 1,017 and Beximcp Pharma was up 1.64 to 211.34.
